q-67085.name: Question 1
q-67085.worked_solution:
Using the distributive law, we multiply each term inside the parentheses by the number $5:$

$$
\begin{aligned}(2a+b)\cdot 5 & = \\ 2a\cdot 5+b\cdot 5 & = \\ 10a+5b\end{aligned}
$$

Using the distributive law, we multiply each term inside the parentheses by the number

$$
\begin{aligned}-8(5p+2q) & = \\ (-8)\cdot 5p+(-8)\cdot 2q & = \\ (-40p)+(-16q) & = \\ -40p-16q\end{aligned}
$$
